blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When a trustworthy Muslim treasurer, by his employer's order, gives wholeheartedly to whomever he was told how much to give, he too will receive the reward of giving charity, like the employer.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا اِلَّا كَانَ مَا اُكِلَ مِنْهُ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَمَا سُرِقَ مِنْهُ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَمَا اَكَلَ السَّبُعُ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَمَا اَكَلَتِ الطَّيْرُ فَهُوَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَا يَرْزَؤُهُ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب فضل الغرس والزرع، رقم: ٣٩٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whichever Muslim plants a tree, then as much as is eaten from that tree, so much reward of giving charity will the one who planted the tree receive. As much as is stolen from it, so much reward of giving charity he will receive (for what was stolen the owner receives the reward of giving charity). As much as animals eat from it, so much reward of giving charity he will receive. As much as birds eat from it, so much reward of giving charity he will receive. Whoever takes even a little (such as fruit) from that tree, the owner of that tree will receive the reward of giving it in charity.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ اَحْيَي اَرْضًا مَيْتَةً، فَلَهُ فِيْهَا اَجْرٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه ابن حبان (واسناده علي شرط مسلم):٦١٥/١١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever makes barren land into cultivated land, there is a reward for him in it,” — so Rasulullah ﷺ said, as narrated by Hazrat
